about: Solar's environment texture library, converted by tools/import_textures.py. CC0 output (textures/env) is committed; commercial output (textures/env_local) is git-ignored and must never be committed. Each set: albedo.png (sRGB), normal.png (OpenGL), orm.png (R AO, G rough, B metal), height.png.
